draft.rationale: This session stays narrow and task-led: first retrieve the stage order and glycolysis location from memory, then build and verify the links, then repair only what the attempt exposes.

coverage.focus: Cellular respiration stage order and glycolysis location.
essentialIdeas: The stages of cellular respiration go in this order: glycolysis, Krebs cycle, electron transport chain.
Glycolysis occurs in the cytoplasm or cytosol and is the first stage.
completionEvidence: Attempt each target without notes and correct any exposed gap

methodBriefing.name: Concept Mapping
methodBriefing.what: You will first answer from memory, then connect the respiration stages and glycolysis location with explicit relationships, then check the evidence and repair any gap.
methodBriefing.why: This fits a short conceptual-learning review because the task is to recall linked facts and verify the exact relationships, not to study a full unit.
how: Answer the first check with no notes.
Build the concept links using the named terms.
Compare your answer to the reference relationship.
Fix only the specific gap that showed up.

activities.label: Try
activities.title: Stage order from memory
activities.body: Without notes, name the stages in order.
activities.correctAnswer: Glycolysis first, Krebs cycle second, electron transport chain third.
activities.feedback: Check the full sequence in order from first to last, not just one stage.

activities.label: Map
activities.title: Connect the stage and location
activities.body: Link each term to its correct relationship.

methodRuntime.instructions: Connect the named concepts using the exact relationship phrase each link needs.

connections.expectedRelationship: occurs in the cytoplasm or cytosol

connections.prompt: What is glycolysis in the pathway?
connections.expectedRelationship: is the first stage of cellular respiration

connections.prompt: What comes after the first stage?
connections.expectedRelationship: is followed by the Krebs cycle

connections.prompt: What comes after the Krebs cycle?
connections.expectedRelationship: is followed by the electron transport chain

activities.correctAnswer: occurs in the cytoplasm or cytosol is the first stage of cellular respiration is followed by the Krebs cycle is followed by the electron transport chain
activities.feedback: The key links are location plus order, so the map should show both where glycolysis happens and what stage comes next.

activities.label: Check
activities.title: Which statement matches the evidence?
activities.body: Pick the statement that matches the correct pathway order.
choices: Krebs cycle, glycolysis, electron transport chain
Glycolysis, Krebs cycle, electron transport chain
Electron transport chain, Krebs cycle, glycolysis
Glycolysis, electron transport chain, Krebs cycle
activities.correctAnswer: Glycolysis, Krebs cycle, electron transport chain
activities.feedback: The correct pathway keeps the stages in their biological sequence, starting with glycolysis and ending with the electron transport chain.

activities.label: Repair
activities.title: Fix the location if needed
activities.body: If you missed the location, answer again in one sentence.
activities.correctAnswer: Glycolysis occurs in the cytoplasm or cytosol.
activities.feedback: Use the cell location, not the mitochondrion, and keep the answer short and exact.
